summary.zh: 设计折扣矩阵、审批门槛与特批流程
summary.en: Design discount matrices, approval thresholds and exceptions

description.zh: 起草或修订销售折扣规则：折扣梯度、各级审批权限、特例处理流程和成交框架。适合销售反馈规则不清、审批混乱，或新财年重订政策时使用。
description.en: Builds or revises discount rules: the discount matrix, approver thresholds by seniority, exception handling and the deal framework sales works within. Use it when rules feel unclear or at fiscal year start.
